title: phaeopappus decurrens
intro: Phaeopappus decurrens, commonly known as  Sclerocarpus decurrens, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Phaeopappus decurrens include analgesic and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating pain and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
